stations.title: Odile
stations.note: The cafe is closed for repairs.

stations.title: Shelf stock
stations.text: Its items were set aside from stock.
stations.note: They must go back on the shelf.

captions: So far you only read. Now the cafe behind order 27 has closed, and it must be cancelled.
Two changes belong together. If only one runs, the shelf and the order disagree.
You write the changes, from a new cafe to this cancel, in three tasks.
Now the stock goes back and the order is cancelled, together or not at all.
Your first writes. Each change touches only the rows it means to.
